name: Beamery
notes: Partners page offers joining the partner network and lists certified SAP and Workday integrations. Homepage, partners page and about page make no mention of a public API. The /developers page returned 404. No headquarters, parent, languages or pricing were stated; the only call to action is Book a demo.

review.note: Support center and Integrations category read; no API, developer or key mention. Developer, API and partner pages were not found, so api_status is unknown. Training subdomain returned an empty page.
